content.text: GAME RECAPApr 14, 2026Spectrum CenterHighlights and bonus content GAME RECAPHeat vs. Hornets: Game highlightsREPLAYHIGHLIGHTFilm Room 4/14: Hornets Simple OffenseHIGHLIGHTFull Replay - Heat vs. HornetsWatch with a subscription Sports for you Questions & answersOn which devices can I watch live sports and events?Live events are supported on web browsers and on more than 650 connected devices via the Prime Video app, including compatible games consoles (PlayStation and Xbox), set-top boxes and media players (such as Google Chromecast, Roku, and Apple TV), smart TVs, Blu-ray players, tablets and mobile phones running iOS or Android. Amazon devices such as the Fire TV and Fire tablet also support live sports. If you don't see live sports on your device, update your app to the latest version. Android: Open the Google Play Store app, search for Prime Video, and then tap Update. iOS: Open the App Store, search for Prime Video, and then tap Update.How can I find live sports and events on Prime Video?All live events are accessible on the Live & upcoming row as you scroll down the main Prime Video home page.Can I record, fast forward, and rewind live sports and events?Which live sports and events can I watch, what do I need to do to watch them, and how can I manage my subscriptions?I still need help watching my live event.If you see "this video is unavailable" or "unavailable due to regional restrictions" that means the game isn't available in your area due to regional or national broadcast rights for that specific game. If you see "enable location for event availability" on mobile devices, location services might be turned off. To fix this, go to your device's settings and turn on location services for Prime Video. If you have anti-virus software, make sure it doesn't block Prime Video from accessing location services. If you see "Home region verification required", please sign in to Prime Video using a device in your home region to verify your location and continue streaming.See more questions and answersFeedback
